title: Adoption sprint-lane and risk notes for inference go-live
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, sprint-lane style tracker to capture milestone ownership, cross-team dependencies, and live blockers for inference feature adoption during the 90-day go-live window. Designed for quick weekly syncs with product, SRE, and the customer success exec sponsor. Use this doc as the single source for QBR narrative fragments and renewal-risk notes.

Scope:
- Focused on inference rollout: hosted API integration + optional Dedicated cutoff and fallback policy.
- Covers technical gates, business KPI acceptance, and operational readiness (alerts, runbooks, cost guardrails).
- Not a full project plan; use for status, risk scoring, and action ownership.

Swimlanes (visualized as logical lanes for weekly standup):
- Customer Integrations: API keys, test dataset uploads, latency baseline validation.
- Infra & Capacity: Dedicated pool readiness, autoscale policies, region failover.
- Observability & Quality: tracing hooks, user-facing error SLO, prompt eval set.
- Contract & Billing: committed throughput, overage thresholds, invoice timeline.
- Escalation & Support: L2 runbooks, on-call rotations, executive escalation point.

Milestone table (rows to copy into a sheet for standup):
1) API smoke + sample app end-to-end
   Owner: Liam Chen
   Target: 2025-02-20
   Status: behind (integration auth edge case)
   Blocker: customer CI blocks due to OAuth redirect mismatch (customer side)
   Risk score: 3/5
   Mitigation: temporary API key + timeboxed security review; CS to coordinate customer SRE ticket.

2) Latency SLA validation (p95 <= 220ms for 90% docs)
   Owner: Priya Desai
   Target: 2025-03-03
   Status: in_progress
   Blocker: nondeterministic cold-starts observed on Dedicated pool
   Risk score: 4/5
   Mitigation: enable warm pool min size, add pre-warm daemon, and run 48h soak; product to approve.

3) Failover policy & routing test
   Owner: Sofia Alvarez
   Target: 2025-03-10
   Status: planned
   Blocker: none yet
   Risk score: 2/5
   Mitigation: schedule DR run with customer and log runbook outcomes.

4) Cost / quota guardrails in Console
   Owner: Maya Thompson
   Target: 2025-02-28
   Status: in_progress
   Blocker: billing SKU mapping for embeddings vs gen not finalized
   Risk score: 3/5
   Mitigation: Finance + Product to finalize SKU mapping this week; temporary manual alerts in place.

Acceptance criteria checklist (per milestone):
- End-to-end test scripts pass in staging for 3 consecutive days.
- Observability shows <1% 5xx and p95 latency target met.
- Runbook exists and is validated by SRE and customer ops.
- Contract amendment executed for Dedicated (if applicable).

Dependency lattice (quick notes):
- Dedicated readiness depends on infra:gpu-pool-provisioning (infra ticket: INF-909).
- Latency tuning depends on model variant shipped (research PR #231) and quantization profile.
- Billing guardrails depend on Finance completing commit mapping (JIRA FIN-114).

Live blockers (sticky list for standup):
- OAuth redirect mismatch — Customer engineering (ACME) needs to update redirect URI whitelist. Owner: Liam Chen (CS) — escalated to ACME SRE.
- Cold-start variance on Dedicated GPUs — infra needs pre-warm config and kernel selection tweak (Owner: Priya; Action: infra ticket raised).
- Missing audit log configuration in Private deployment (if customer chooses private) — blocker for compliance check. Owner: Maya.

Risk scoring legend:
1 = low (unlikely to affect milestone), 5 = critical (likely to delay go-live). Use conservative scoring for QBR narrative.

Notes to self / messy brainstorm (copy into QBR bullets):
- Mention fallback: routed to hosted-compact model if Dedicated pool saturated; highlight cost delta in QBR.
- Check whether the customer requires data residency logs — if yes, prioritize private audit log setup.
- Add a short blurb for exec: "Targeting production for 90-day pilot; renewal decision expected at pilot close — current risk: medium due to latency and billing mapping."

Suggested weekly sync agenda (15 min):
- 2 min: quick red/amber/green callouts
- 5 min: top 2 blockers + owners and immediate actions
- 5 min: infra/product integration updates
- 3 min: ask/asks for customer (decisions needed)

Immediate actions (this week):
- [Liam] Get ACME to add temporary API key for smoke tests (due 2025-02-16).
- [Priya] Deploy warm pool config to staging and run 24h soak (due 2025-02-17).
- [Maya] Confirm billing SKU mapping with Finance and send proposed amendment (due 2025-02-18).

Open questions for product / legal:
- Can we offer a short-term grace threshold for token overages during pilot? (Legal/Finance input needed)
- What is the minimum accepted audit log retention to satisfy ACME compliance?

QBR-ready summary paragraph (copyable):
"Pilot progress: Integration smoke tests underway; primary technical risks are Dedicated cold-start variance and pending billing SKU mapping. CS and infra teams have timeboxed mitigations underway; expected to meet renewal conditions if technical gates close on schedule. Current overall risk: medium (3/5)."

Historic notes and links (for context):
- initial kickoff: 2024-12-05 (meeting notes in Confluence)
- previous risk log: linked_artifacts: JIRA:CS-4721
- Slack channel: #cs-acme-thread (pin: integration-issue)

End.
